raw_segments.text: A listless lady, no more young, walked alone the shore of Loch Inel, merry, first countess
of Belvedere, listlessly walking in the evening, not startled when an otter plunged.
Not the jealous Lord Belvedere and not her confessor if she had not committed adultery
fully, iculatio seminis intervass Naturale Mularis, with her husband's brother.
She would half confess if she had not all sinned as women did.
Only God knew when she and he, her husband's brother.
